slides: Your muscles tire before your mind does.
Because you train the same lift every session.
Repetition breeds neural adaptation, not resilience.
Introduce a new range, angle, or tempo each week.
Your body stays fresh, performance keeps climbing.
Willpower is a battery, not an infinite well.
Every tiny choice drains a fraction of its charge.
When the battery dips, defaults win.
Automate the low‑stakes decisions in advance.
Reserve mental energy for what truly matters.
You can lift heavy, but sleep light.
Growth hormone spikes in the first 90 minutes of deep sleep.
Missing that window stalls muscle repair.
Prioritize a consistent bedtime over a later cardio session.
Strength follows the night, not the gym.
Big goals are just collections of micro‑wins.
If your daily actions don't point to the goal, they're noise.
Map each habit to a specific metric of progress.
Check the map each morning; adjust or discard.
Alignment turns ambition into inevitability.
